description: Ministry of Science Technology & Research - The Intellectual  Property Regulation (Songs and Musical Work) No. 01 2019
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister under the Intellectual Property Act, No. 36 of 2003. It establishes legal requirements for royalty payments, usage agreements, and copyright protections for songs and musical works. The content focuses entirely on creating a regulatory framework for intellectual property rights, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5). While it mentions a government minister, it does not focus on government structure, personnel changes, or detailed portfolio responsibilities.
